question: Hello. My little Oda! I want to know how Kid stole Big Mom's Poneglyph! Sending you lots of kisses! Valentin
answer: Yes. The mistranslations are cute too. This one is from France. I'll kiss you ♡. First, Kid attacked the Big Mom Pirates' ship and defeated the officer Snack. When Snack begged for his life, Kid demanded a copy of the Road Poneglyph, then left after getting it. Although people thought that Kid ran away from Big Mom when he left, in reality he just achieved his goal.
name: CATELA Valentin
